_comment: Serial, packet, and UI settings. Controls are defined in code in drive_modes.py and are not editable at runtime.

safety._comment: weapon_password_sha256 gates the weapon unlock button. This is an interlock against ACCIDENTAL weapon activation, not access control: anyone who can edit this file can replace the hash, and anyone who can edit station.py can remove the check entirely. Set it with 'python station.py --set-weapon-password'. An empty string means the unlock button still needs a deliberate click-through, just no password.
safety._comment_dongle: failsafe_on_dongle_removal: if the dongle leaves USB, latch a killswitch so the robot is deep-slept the moment it is reconnected. Great for bench tests (unplug = guaranteed kill). Turn OFF for matches, where a momentary USB glitch would otherwise permanently kill the bot mid-fight instead of riding out the blip.
